id: title:dmarchuk:fetch batch audiences in pages of 5000 persons

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and validation for HogFlow batch processing, allowing users to tune audience resolution batch sizes while preventing unbounded page sizes.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement: it introduces a configurable batch size parameter with a default and a runtime validation check to prevent configuration errors. This changes HogFlow behavior from a fixed batch size to a configurable one, while adding a safeguard against invalid settings. This is a reliability and usability improvement, not a systemic risk
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the HogFlow batch trigger or HogQL query execution, so the tier cannot be established. The score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds a Django import and a runtime configuration check.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the WORKFLOWS_PERSON_BATCH_SIZE setting and raises an error if it is less than 1, preventing an unbounded page size configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration variable and its validation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog users to configure the batch size for workflow audience resolution, with a default of 5000 and a minimum of 1.

observations.behavior: Changes the batch size variable used in HogFlow workflow execution.
